<!-- The SVG modebar (js/plotting/svg-modebar.js) in every situation it has
     to tell apart. Each case is a div with an id the check looks up:
       #in-block   Plot in an .ojs-chart-block with a slider: one bar, on
                   the block, kept through a re-run; the figure centered.
       #bare       Plot in a bare cell: one bar, on the cell's output
                   wrapper; the figure not moved.
       #off        Plot under data-vm-modebar="off": no bar.
       #hand-built a hand-built <svg> in .ojs-chart-block.ojs-svg-block: one bar.
       #plotly     a Plotly chart and a Plot chart in one block: no bar
                   showing (Plotly's modebar has fullscreen).
       #ramp       Plot's color-ramp legend alone in a cell: no bar. -->

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

<div id="in-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls">

```{ojs}
viewof mbCount = Inputs.range([2, 40], {step: 1, value: 20, label: "Points"})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
{
  const points = []
  for (let i = 0; i < mbCount; i++) points.push([i, Math.sin(i / 3)])
  return Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({
    width: 480, height: 300,
    marks: [Plot.line(points, {stroke: chartColors.fn})]
  }))
}
```

</div>

</div>

<div id="bare">

```{ojs}
{
  const points = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) points.push([i, Math.cos(i / 3)])
  return Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({
    width: 480, height: 300,
    marks: [Plot.line(points, {stroke: chartColors.alt})]
  }))
}
```

</div>

<div id="off" data-vm-modebar="off">

```{ojs}
Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({width: 480, height: 200, marks: [Plot.dot([[0, 0], [1, 1]], {fill: chartColors.ok})]}))
```

</div>

<div id="hand-built">

<div class="ojs-chart-block ojs-svg-block">

```{ojs}
{
  const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg")
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 400 200")
  svg.setAttribute("width", "400")
  svg.setAttribute("height", "200")
  svg.innerHTML = `<rect x="10" y="10" width="380" height="180" fill="none" stroke="${chartColors.ink}"/>`
  return svg
}
```

</div>

</div>

<div id="plotly">

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

```{ojs}
{
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.style.height = "240px"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [{x: [0, 1, 2], y: [0, 1, 0], showlegend: false, line: {color: chartColors.fn}}], VM.plotting.layout({}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({width: 300, height: 120, marks: [Plot.dot([[0, 0], [1, 1]], {fill: chartColors.ok})]}))
```

</div>

</div>

<div id="ramp">

```{ojs}
Plot.legend({color: {type: "linear", domain: [0, 1]}, width: 320})
```

</div>
